proceedings.outcome: the applicant was declared to be partially incapacitated
proceedings.supporting_quote: In a judgment of 20 November 2000, the court declared the applicant to be partially incapacitated on the grounds that he had been suffering from simple schizophrenia since 1975
That judgment was upheld in a judgment of 12 April 2001 by the Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal ( Апелативен съд ) on an appeal by the applicant

proceedings.outcome: Ms R.P. was appointed as the applicant’s guardian until 31 December 2002
proceedings.supporting_quote: on 23 May 2002 the Municipal Council appointed Ms R.P., a council officer, as the applicant’s guardian until 31 December 2002

proceedings.outcome: the Director of the Pastra social care home was appointed as the applicant’s guardian
proceedings.supporting_quote: the Municipal Council had decided on 2 February 2005 to appoint the Director of the Pastra social care home as the applicant’s guardian

proceedings.outcome: refused to bring an action for restoration of the applicant’s legal capacity
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 10 August 2005 the regional prosecutor refused to bring an action for restoration of the applicant’s legal capacity

proceedings.outcome: the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld
proceedings.supporting_quote: the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld on 11 October 2005 by the appellate prosecutor

proceedings.deciding_body: Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation
proceedings.outcome: the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld
proceedings.supporting_quote: and subsequently on 29 November 2005 by the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation
parties: Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation (deciding body)

proceedings.outcome: refused the request to bring a court action for release from partial guardianship
proceedings.supporting_quote: In a letter of 16 September 2005, the mayor of Rila refused his request

proceedings.outcome: the application for judicial review was dismissed
proceedings.supporting_quote: The Dupnitsa District Court gave judgment on 10 March 2006. [...] As to the merits, the court dismissed the application
